tasks.title: Development: reversible list ordering
tasks.brief: A reading list supports manual reordering but currently requires dragging. Design a keyboard-accessible alternative for a list of 40 items.
constraints: Moving an item must be reversible until the page closes.
success_criteria: A user can move an item to a chosen position and undo it.

tasks.title: Development: temporary cache
tasks.brief: A small service caches public records for at most five minutes. A slow source can time out.
constraints: An expired record cannot be labeled fresh.
success_criteria: An outage has an explicit response and eviction behavior.

tasks.title: Development: shared-room checkout
tasks.brief: A club lends a shared meeting room key between two volunteers. The current chat thread makes the location unclear.
constraints: A handoff must record its time.
success_criteria: The current holder and unresolved handoffs can be identified.

tasks.title: Development: source-bound glossary
tasks.brief: An editor maintains definitions linked to supplied source passages. A definition may be disputed.
constraints: Every definition needs a source passage ID.
success_criteria: A reader can inspect the source and disagreement.
